exposure: difficulty in forming a bladder flap
outcome: urinary bladder injury during caesarean section
cohort: The study included 18 cases of bladder injury during caesarean section and 36 controls who had caesarean sections without bladder injury, collected between January 2006 and December 2020.
finding: Previous caesarean section, dense adhesions, and difficulty in forming a bladder flap were statistically significant risk factors for bladder injury during caesarean section.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as the most important risk factor for urinary bladder injury during caesarean section.
